notes: Lofty Denial, printed: 'Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1}. If you control a creature with flying, counter that spell unless its controller pays {4} instead.' The condition is read as Lofty Denial RESOLVES (CR 608.2c), not as it is cast. Seat 1 casts it while it controls a flier; the flier leaves the battlefield while Lofty Denial waits on the stack. When it resolves there is no creature with flying: the tax is the base {1}, seat 0's one {R} pays it and the Shieldmate resolves. (The step after a held cast settles the stack, so it carries the answer word PAY.)
